tasks.short: Support environmental project planning and compliance review

steps.what: Collect the actual project version and engineer-identified requirements, checking source versions and capturing comparison fields
inputs: Project plans produced by the engineering team
Applicable requirement and policy sources identified by the responsible engineer
outputs: Version-linked project facts and requirement fields, with gaps marked

steps.what: Stage exact project fields against explicit requirement identifiers and calculate stated numerical comparisons
inputs: Explicit comparison formulas and units supplied by the engineer
outputs: Traceable comparison table with mismatches and missing fields flagged

steps.what: Evaluate technical planning issues with engineering staff, investigate exceptions and determine support findings within the assigned scope
outputs: Technician's technical findings and unresolved questions for the engineer

steps.what: Write the actual planning-support note and check its complete findings, citations and comparison table
inputs: Actual findings and open questions from s3
outputs: Complete checked support note, explicitly pending engineering determination where needed

steps.what: Save the checked planning-support note in the project record
inputs: Exact complete final note from s4
outputs: Saved support note available within the existing project workspace

tasks.design: Use {SPREADSHEET} native tables and formulas to assemble exact comparisons from checked project facts and engineer-supplied requirements. Reuse those fields in a {DOCS} support-note form while the technician writes the findings and checks the complete version before saving in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project facts, requirement references and support findings may require repeated manual comparison and entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native table links, formulas and document fields can preserve exact identifiers and explicitly specified numerical checks.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, engineering feasibility and the significance of exceptions require qualified judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise incomplete evidence, investigate technical concerns and escalate interpretation to the responsible engineer.

ambition.what: Recheck the same explicit comparisons against a revised project version after the engineer confirms the scope.

reach.task: Determine requirement applicability and resolve engineering questions
reach.learn: Provide explicit sources, comparison definitions and the disposition of unresolved findings

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native spreadsheets can compare explicit structured fields and formulas, and document forms can reuse confirmed project identifiers without deciding regulatory applicability.

assumptions: Representative conditional support episode where the technician actually creates a project-support note and manually assembles comparison tables; this is not a measured baseline or a claim about every support conversation.

Engineering staff already produce project plans and identify applicable sources as part of their substantive work. Technician collection, source/version checking and field capture are counted in s1; applicability or source research missing from that existing process must remain human and be added rather than assumed free.

Only explicit identifier matching and engineer-defined calculations are automated in s2. Missing units, ambiguous provisions, incomplete drawings and unstructured passages stop the comparison and remain in s1 or s3; no inferred compliance result.
Native features first; current calculation runtime and any existing equivalent links are baseline. The s2 saving applies only to demonstrated manual assembly and transfer.

In s4 fixed project and source fields account for the limited reduction; technical writing and the complete final check remain. The final note does not certify compliance, authorize plant operation or submit a permit. Any such decision requires its own final-version engineering approval and separate action, outside this support-note boundary.
Engineering consultations in s3 remain active human work; no saving in the engineer's effort is claimed. Other-role effort is not included in the focal task arithmetic.
Illustrative focal effort totals 100. Gross saving 20 plus 2.4 equals 22.4, less 3 incremental upkeep gives net 19.4. Saving the same-system record is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: Actual requirement source ownership, current comparison workflow and project-note practice
research_questions: Which exact field comparisons currently require manual transfer, and which findings require engineering interpretation?

already_counted.description: Source and field capture, technical consultation and retained note writing and final checking

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and explicit comparison formulas and retest them after project schema changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete support note and table checked in s4; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional unmeasured manual comparison and field-reuse scenario: gross 22.4 minus upkeep 3; all technical and regulatory judgements retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Work with the responsible engineer on explicit sources and exception resolution
skills_to_grow: Configure native tables and document fields
role.ambitious_version: The technician supplies traceable project evidence and technical findings while engineers retain design and compliance authority.
